```yaml
name: 🚀 Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: 🚀 Deploy Lexical Search Worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: lexical-search-worker-production
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-lexical-search-worker-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: ⬇️ Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: ⎔ Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: 📥 Install lexical search worker deps
        run: npm ci --workspace=lexical-search-worker

      - name: 🔬 Lint lexical search worker
        run: npm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: ʦ Typecheck lexical search worker
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: 🧪 Test lexical search worker
        run: npm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: ☁️ Deploy via Wrangler
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: deploy

  sync:
    name: 🔄 Sync Lexical Search Data
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: ⬇️ Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: ⎔ Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: 📥 Install site deps
        run: npm ci --workspace=kentcdodds.com

      - name: 🔄 Sync lexical data from R2 to D1
        run: node other/semantic-search/sync-lexical-data.ts
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          D1_DATABASE_ID: ${{ secrets.LEXICAL_SEARCH_D1_DATABASE_ID }}
          R2_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET }}
          LEXICAL_SEARCH_WORKER_URL: ${{ secrets.LEXICAL_SEARCH_WORKER_URL }}
          LEXICAL_SEARCH_WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.LEXICAL_SEARCH_WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN }}
```
